1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R595)
K8s IoT MCP Platform, Rust Knowledge OS, AEGIS Desktop & Motive
Q1: Kubernetes IoT Platform with User-Scoped MCP & HITL?
• devicechain-io/devicechain (★8, Apache-2.0, Go):
MQTT, Sparkplug B, LwM2M & LoRaWAN ingest on Kubernetes
MCP server reads with user's own token; alarm ack waits
• Zero device cap & single Apache-2.0 edition (no paywall)
Q2: Rust Enterprise Knowledge Compilation OS?
• alexeyban/EKOS (★28, MIT, Rust):
Continuously reconstructs, compiles, stores & serves
enterprise knowledge into structured agent context
• Passes SonarCloud Reliability, Security & Quality Gates
Q3: Mission-Control Desktop Client for OpenClaw v6.0.0?
• rshodoskar-star/openclaw-desktop (★120, MIT, TS):
AEGIS Desktop (`v6.0.0`) on Electron 35 + React 18 + TS 5.7
Targets OpenClaw `2026.3.12+` without browser tab clutter
• Full bilingual English/Arabic UI with native RTL layout
Q4: Swift 6.0 Menu-Bar Background Agent ("Say It, Walk Away")?
• geezerrrr/motive (★120, MIT, Swift 6.0, macOS 15+):
Runs autonomous AI tasks invisibly from macOS menu bar
Interrupts user only when a high-impact decision requires
explicit approval
2. End-to-End Enterprise IoT MCP, Compiled Knowledge OS & Mission-Control Desktop Architecture
Four-Pillar Stack: DeviceChain K8s IoT MCP ➔ EKOS Rust Knowledge Compiler ➔ AEGIS OpenClaw Desktop ➔ Motive Menu-Bar
Pillar A: K8s IoT Platform + MCP (devicechain)
• Industrial Protocol Breadth: Ingests MQTT, HTTP, Sparkplug B,
LwM2M & LoRaWAN with rules, alarms, commands & OTA updates
• Zero-Privilege-Escalation MCP: MCP server reads devices
and telemetry using the signed-in user's own RBAC token
• Human-in-the-Loop Alarm Safety: Agent proposals to ack or
clear industrial alarms wait for explicit human approval
• No Device Cap: Single open Apache-2.0 edition on Kubernetes
✓ Eliminates per-device cloud IoT fees & unsafe alarm clearing
Pillar B: Rust Knowledge Compiler (alexeyban/EKOS)
• Continuous Knowledge Reconstruction: Compiles raw scattered
enterprise artifacts into reconciled, query-ready knowledge
• Rust Memory Safety & Speed: High-throughput indexing and
serving engine verified by SonarCloud Quality Gates
• Beyond Naive Chunking: Resolves conflicting document versions
during compilation rather than dumping contradictory chunks
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Replaces stale wiki chunk soup with compiled knowledge
Pillar C: AEGIS Mission Control (openclaw-desktop v6.0.0)
• Dedicated Gateway Cockpit: Turns OpenClaw `2026.3.12+`
into a native desktop mission-control center
• Modern Desktop Stack: Built with Electron 35, React 18 &
TypeScript 5.7 (`v6.0.0` release)
• Global Enterprise Accessibility: First-class bilingual
English and Arabic localization with complete RTL layout
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Isolates OpenClaw operations from accidental browser closes
Pillar D: Ambient macOS Agent Runner (geezerrrr/motive)
• "Say It. Walk Away." UX: Native Swift 6.0 menu-bar app
for `macOS 15+` that runs background agent workflows quietly
• Attention-Preserving Escalation: Stays out of the way
while agents execute, notifying you only when approval is needed
• Zero Window Clutter: Eliminates 10 open terminal windows
competing for focus on developer desktops
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Preserves deep-work focus during background agent execution
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R36-R595-DEVICECHAIN-EKOS-OPENCLAWDESKTOP-MOTIVE · 45 Eng @ $100/h)
Path A: Metered IoT Cloud + Wiki SaaS + Agent Babysitting
• Per-Device IoT Cloud & Knowledge SaaS: $3,360.00 / mo
• Alarm Triage & Babysitting: 41.0 h/mo × $100/h = $4,100.00 / mo
• Overhead: Punitive per-sensor IoT tiers, contradictory
RAG wiki chunks & constant context-switching across tabs
Path C: All-Permissive OSS (DeviceChain + EKOS + AEGIS + Motive)
• Self-Hosted K8s IoT & Rust EKOS Compute: $80.00 / mo
• HITL Alarm & Knowledge Review: 2.5 h/mo × $100 = $250.00 / mo
• Outcome: Unlimited K8s IoT devices with RBAC MCP, compiled
Rust knowledge OS, AEGIS v6.0.0 & Swift 6.0 menu-bar agents
Verified Closed-Form ROI & Governance Summary
• Monthly Net Savings: $7,130.00 / mo (-95.58%)
• Annualized Savings: $85,560.00 / yr
• License Gate: 100% Permissive Open Source (DeviceChain =
